exposure: Patients receiving spinal anesthesia with a 25G needle
Volumetric flow rate of local anesthetic
Patients receiving spinal anesthesia with a 29G needle
cohort: The study included 84 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section.
finding: While both 25G and 29G spinal needles provided sufficient block levels for cesarean section, the 29G needle was associated with a lower incidence of maternal hypotension and bradycardia.
